name: V.O.L.T. (Volunteer Opportunities and Leadership for Teens)
org: City of Buena Park Community Services
what_you_do: Help at city programs, such as gym and park programs, youth sports and special events. You earn community service hours and build skills.
who_can_apply: Teens 13 to 17. You do not need to live in Buena Park.
pay_detail: Volunteer. You earn community service hours.
duration: Ongoing. General meeting once a month.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. General meetings are the first Tuesday of every month at 5:00 p.m.
how_to_apply: Get the application from the program page. Bring it to a meeting, or email it first to volt@buenapark.com. Parents can come to meetings too.
notes: Meetings are at the Buena Park Community Center, 6688 Beach Blvd. Call (714) 562-3860. There is also a V.O.L.T. Committee of 7 teens with a one year term. Its page says applications open in November and interviews are in December. It gives no year or closing date, so call to check.
